verdict.rationale: Bolna publishes an open-source voice framework on GitHub, and its docs describe self-hosting Bolna on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes. However, the self-host page sits under the enterprise on-premise section, and nothing in the evidence confirms that the documented self-hosted runtime is built from the open-source code. Coverage of the full story is therefore incomplete. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the open-source repo is the deployable runtime used for self-hosting, clarity on whether self-hosting is enterprise-gated, detailed deployment steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a successful self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Bolna is the end-to-end open source production ready framework for quickly building LLM based voice driven conversational applications.
Learn how to self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments.
